scope: Read-only review of the simplified explicit-feasibility paragraph only; no edits, builds, restoration of other local changes, or broader theory review.
verdict: The stated convex-fold sum is a valid feasible pair for the existing facetwise constraints.
checks: Across each positive fold of f, the included maximum contributes the matching nonnegative slope jump; other summands cannot reduce it. Negative jumps of f also give nonnegative jumps of g-f.
For adjacent arrangement cells, q_i-q_j vanishes on their shared facet hyperplane. Each maximum therefore changes formula only on an existing arrangement hyperplane and is affine on every P_i.
Continuity and convexity of g and h imply nonnegative oriented facet coefficients; their restrictions satisfy g_i-h_i=q_i and the stated affine jump identities.
The empty-sum case gives g=0 and h=-f and is covered by the same argument.
